formula.name: Green Patchouli Cologne V3 — Citrus Patchouli Chypre
formula.body:
### STEP 1 — BASE (add first, swirl after every 3)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|
| 1 | Galaxolide | 50% in DEP | 700 | 0.700 |
| 2 | Patchouli EO | neat | 400 | 0.400 |
| 3 | Clearwood | neat | 350 | 0.350 |
| 4 | Benzyl Salicylate | neat | 300 | 0.300 |
| 5 | Ambrox Super | 30% w/v | 300 | 0.300 |
| 6 | Vetiver EO | neat | 280 | 0.280 |
| 7 | Romandolide | neat | 250 | 0.250 |
| 8 | Cedramber | neat | 250 | 0.250 |
| 9 | Coumarin | 20% in EtOH | 150 | 0.150 |
| 10 | Evernyl | neat | 25 | 0.025 |

**Base subtotal: 3,005 µL**

---

### STEP 2 — HEART (add second, swirl after each)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|
| 11 | Hedione | neat | 500 | 0.500 |
| 12 | Iso E Super | neat | 250 | 0.250 |
| 13 | Lavender EO | neat | 150 | 0.150 |
| 14 | Geraniol | neat | 200 | 0.200 |
| 15 | Vanillin | 10% in DPG | 300 | 0.300 |
| 16 | Dihydrojasmone | neat | 60 | 0.060 |
| 17 | Azarbre | neat | 30 | 0.030 |

**Heart subtotal: 1,490 µL**

---

### STEP 3 — TOP (add last, work quickly, cap immediately)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|
| 18 | Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian | neat | 400 | 0.400 |
| 19 | Grapefruit FCF | neat | 120 | 0.120 |
| 20 | Petitgrain EO | neat | 50 | 0.050 |
| 21 | Black Pepper EO | neat | 80 | 0.080 |

**Top subtotal: 650 µL**

---

### STEP 4 — ETHANOL

| # | Material | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----|----|
| 22 | Ethanol 96% | 24,855 | 24.855 |

Add in 3 portions (~8 mL each). Swirl 15 seconds between each.

---

**Concentrate: 5,145 µL (17.2%) · Total: 30,000 µL · 30 mL · 21 materials**

---

## MACERATION

| Day | Expectation |
|-----|-------------|
| 0 | Patchouli raw, Iso E sharp — do not evaluate |
| 7 | Dihydrojasmone integrating with lavender |
| **14** | **First evaluation** — Azarbre dark halo should be present |
| 30 | Peak — Vanillin + patchouli gestalt fully fused |
| 45 | Vetiver depth developed |

*All materials verified against inventory.txt. Pipeline: pending.*

diagnostics: ℹ Dense lipophilic base — deep skin absorption, slow evolution
Blooming materials (Iso-E-effect): Galaxolide, Galaxolide, Patchouli EO, Patchouli EO, Clearwood
Perceptual channels: 15 (8 cross-adaptation groups + 7 solo materials) from 21 ingredients
Channel model: 14 materials collapsed into 8 group channels (Laing ceiling applies to channels, not ingredients)
• woody_amber: Iso E Super, Clearwood, Ambrox Super (3 → 1 channel)
• citrus_terpene: Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian, Grapefruit FCF (2 → 1 channel)
Genetic anosmia risk: 1.8% of formula mass affected by OR variants
✓ All profiled materials within positive character range
ℹ Near character-shift boundary: Galaxolide, Hedione, Iso E Super — small dose changes could shift perceived character
Far-field: Lavender EO, Dihydrojasmone, Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian, Grapefruit FCF, Petitgrain EO
Mid-field: Patchouli EO, Ambrox Super, Vetiver EO, Cedramber, Coumarin
Near-field: Galaxolide, Clearwood, Benzyl Salicylate, Romandolide, Vanillin
